Priya: FYI spotted ~$11.8k in GPU charges across europe-west1/europe-north1 tied to 'playground-trial' over last 48h. Many rows untagged and a lot look like duplicates — likely cross-region failover double-metering. Can we reconcile before month close? cc @Samir @Mia

cost-bot: Alert: GPU anomaly detected for project redwood-playground. Peak QPS 2.9k, billing delta +$11,823 in 48h. Report: https://billing.internal/reports/playground-anomaly

Samir: Thanks. Can you paste the raw export or run the metering join? I'll check if the meter_id changed during failover.

Mia: pasting quick query I used to find duplicates — rough but shows same instance_id with two region tags during overlapping timestamps:

```
SELECT instance_id, meter_id, region, SUM(cost) as total_cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE project='redwood-playground' AND ts >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY instance_id, meter_id, region
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT region) > 1;
```

Alex: If it's double-metered we can ask GCP for a correction, but for month end finance needs allocation. Recommend we allocate 70% to 'playground' (customer trials) and 30% to 'infra-failover-safety' budget and then request vendor credit. Thoughts?

Priya: :thinking_face: vendor credit procedure?

Samir: Procedure: open case with billing_support, include csv of meter_ids and timestamps, ask for invoice adjustment. I'll prepare CSV. Also we should tag historical rows in our cost DB with label `duplicate_failover` so dashboards stop spiking.

Mia: I ran a quick join and here are sample rows (snippet):
instance-1234, meter-A, europe-west1, 2026-03-22T02:14Z, 3.2
instance-1234, meter-B, europe-north1, 2026-03-22T02:15Z, 3.3

I'll push tags with a backfill script tonight.

Priya: Great. @Alex can you provision internal credit of $3.5k to cover temporarily? We'll chase vendor for remainder.

Alex: I'll approve emergency internal credit of $3.5k, finance req id: FIN-2026-0423. Please record in the ledger and tag the transaction with `playground-temp-credit`.

cost-bot: Ticket created: Case 987654 with GCP billing_support. Expect vendor response in 3-5 business days.

Samir: Follow-ups: I'll run the backfill script, Mia please share the exact SQL patch. Priya I'll send note to customers impacted (playground) with a heads-up and short explanation.

Mia: Sharing SQL patch in #eng-infra after prod check. Script will set label=duplicate_failover and add attributed_team='playground' where instance in csv. Backfill PR will include safety fences so it only touches rows that match both overlapping meter_ids and contiguous timestamps.

Priya: :thumbsup: thanks all. Will mark as actioned when tags pushed and credit hits ledger.

Alex: Once GCP responds we'll reconcile actual vendor credit vs internal charge and adjust month-end allocations. Leaving this thread open until vendor confirms.
